Cikcakk (03 §4.2 G)

Abbreviations (US terms)
ch – chain
dc – double crochet
st(s) – stitch(es)
tog – together

Stitch key (US terms)
chain (ch)
double crochet (dc)
decrease (dec): dc2tog
decrease (dec): dc3tog
increase (inc): 3 dc in same st

Cikcakk
Row 1 – foundation: ch 28.
Row 2: skip 3 ch, dc2tog, 4 dc, 3 dc in next ch, 4 dc, dc3tog, 4 dc, 3 dc in next ch, 4 dc, dc2tog (25 sts). Turn.
Row 3: ch 3 (turning chain), dc2tog, 4 dc, 3 dc in next st, 4 dc, dc3tog, 4 dc, 3 dc in next st, 4 dc, dc2tog (25 sts). Fasten off.
